Raventós i Blanc cuenta con una de las tradiciones vitivinícolas documentadas más longevas del mundo. Desde 1497, veintiuna generaciones de la familia Raventós han trabajado este terruño de viñedo y bosque en la Conca del Riu Anoia. Cinco siglos de dedicación al cultivo y una saga ligada a esta tierra generación tras generación.
La finca Raventós i Blanc consta de 90 hectáreas y 44 parcelas de viñedo con variedades autóctonas, en un espacio que cuenta con un microclima marcado por el río Anoia, un lago, dos torrentes y la colina del Serral, así como una biodiversidad que la hace única.
El compromiso de Raventós i Blanc es elaborar vinos que sean un reflejo fiel de la parcela, la variedad y la añada. El viñedo, la autenticidad, el detalle y la pureza constituyen su base principal.
Pepe Raventós es la 21.ª generación que cultiva la finca siguiendo la agricultura ecológica y biodinámica. Fiel a la tradición, sitúa la relación entre el ser humano y la naturaleza en el centro de su filosofía de elaboración de vinos espumosos de la finca.

For over a decade, Pura Vida has solidified its reputation as a wildly popular lifestyle brand, resonating with consumers everywhere with its colorful, surf-inspired aesthetic as well as its mission to support artisans and charities around the world. Entrepreneur spotlighted its bottle-rocket growth with a $100 investment by two friends “running with a determination to do something different after college and a willingness to bet on themselves,” valued at $130 million.

Pura Vida continues to expand its culturally rich offerings of stackable jewelry, accessories and apparel, allowing consumers to shop by charity or collection, and even to customize pieces by color and material. The company embraces the highest standards of craftsmanship, partnering with more than 800 highly skilled artisans in Costa Rica, El Salvador and India, who benefit from its sustainable and fair-trade employment. The popularity of Pura Vida can be seen in a robust social media community of 2.2 million Instagram followers, and the August 2021 opening of its first retail store in San Diego.

Pura Aventura creates award-winning sustainable holidays away from the crowds, tailoring beautiful walks, natural wonders and local flavour in Latin America, Spain & Portugal. 

Since 2019, Pura Aventura has been creating an environmental legacy for its clients, donating 1% of its revenues to an award-winning, fully-accredited reforestation project. In doing so they carbon balance every holiday by 160% - a mile for every kilometre travelled from front door and back again. 

In 2020 Pura Aventura become one of the first travel companies in the UK to certify as a B Corp, and in 2021 was the first UK tour operator to publish the total carbon footprint of each trip including international flights.​
